order: Pilot (30-min gate): Kabuki B, then Tron B. Then Kabuki A, DOA3 B, DOA3 A, ToeJam B. B before A in each fresh pair, so a shader-module cache kept from the previous run on the same apk favours A, not B.
judge: python3 docs/lanes/uberdefault569/judge.py --pair Kabuki <A> <B> --pair DOA3 <A> <B> --pair ToeJam <A> <B> --pair Tron <A> <B> (--selftest passes). Readings, legs and FACTORS are in its docstring, fixed before any run. On the two runs already on disk for Tron (run 6 as A, run 7 as B) it reads V, H, S1 (0.059), S2 (3 -> 0) true.
prediction: #569 ubershader on by default. uberspike569 measured the ladder (HAKUX_GPL=3) on two titles: Kabuki's fight 133 s -> 27 ms of draw-path creates, DOA1U 26.2 s -> 2.7 s, and its uber vertex stage held on every draw was byte-identical on 1317 suite captures. #672 run 7 took Tron 2.0's cold New Game path past the card where run 6 hung. This build makes 3 the default and adds an Android setting that turns it off. Predicted, on cold first launches (no pipeline cache file, nothing pre-built): H, no B arm hangs, crashes, or fails to reach gameplay that its A reached; S1, per title B's draw-path create ms <= 0.50 x A's; S2, summed over titles B's shader-class hitches in the first 120 s after `mark gameplay` < A's, and no title's B exceeds its A by more than 1; F, per title except Tron (whose A hung), B's fps_ok_share >= A's - 0.10. Each B must log [gpl569] requested=3 mode=3 and a last [uber569] with links > 0, and each A [gpl569] mode=0; both arms cold by [pb569]. Otherwise the pair is VOID.

legs.V (validity): per pair, as the prediction's last sentence. A VOID pair scores nothing.
legs.H: every B: verdict.json hang false, crash false, reached_gameplay true unless its A's was false. FAILS in the world where a stand-in pipeline wedges the GPU or the swap frees a pipeline still in flight.
legs.S1: per pair, B dpc_ms <= 0.50 x A's. FAILS where a title's cold misses (no uber library yet for a (family, GS, raster, formats) combination) dominate, as DOA1U's 14 cold combinations did in part, or where its vertex states are uncovered ([uber569] uncovered=).
legs.S2: first 120 s after mark gameplay, shader-class hitches (hitch_report's classifier): sum B < sum A, and each B <= A + 1. FAILS where the early hitches are cold combinations or are not compile-bound.
legs.F: per pair except Tron, B fps_ok_share >= A - 0.10. 0.10 is a registered tolerance, not a measured noise band. FAILS where the stand-in's GPU cost (uberspike569 G: up to 3.8x per frame held, 0.79x median gfps over DOA1U's cold play span) lasts long enough to move the share. This is the leg most at risk.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures. The legs are read off logcat and verdict.json by judge.py.
